blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On the first day of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill’s endorsement on the Senate floor, the funding for the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), the Department of Economy, Planning, and Development (DepDev), and the Department of Finance (DOF) was submitted to the plenary without interpellation from lawmakers. Under the Senate finance panel’s proposal of the P7.2-trillion national budget, the Department of Budget and Management received P3,007,734,000; while DepDev got P15,919,025,000.
